question: Does Bestre et al. (2018) provide reusable, site-resolved fish evidence for Benguet rivers and Ambuklao Dam?

source.title: Fishes and shell diversity in major rivers of Benguet, Philippines
source.publisherArchive: Istros Publishing House / Museum of Brăila ‘Carol I’

study.claimedDesign: The methods report 11 sampling sites, selecting at least one river or tributary per municipality; the article describes a mix of tributaries and headwaters across major northern Luzon systems.
study.methods: The paper describes mixed collection gears, laboratory handling/identification, and interviews with nearby fisherfolk to validate specimens and identify species not caught. The published checklist does not distinguish, row by row, which records derive from captured specimens versus interview reports.
study.specimenCustody: The article says preserved specimens were deposited and displayed in the Biology Department of Benguet State University; no catalog or accession numbers are provided in the reviewed text.
study.siteSelection: The study intentionally selected rivers not considered heavily polluted by mining, agricultural runoff, or domestic waste. It is therefore not a random or comprehensive survey of all Benguet waters.
study.spatialDetail: A province map is included, but no machine-readable station coordinates or surveyed river geometry were found in the reviewed methods, tables, or figure captions.

qualityAndRights.siteCountDiscrepancy: Methods say 11 sampling sites; figure/table analysis lists 12 units (11 named rivers plus Ambuklao Dam). The relationship between sites and analytical units is not resolved by the reviewed text.
qualityAndRights.presenceMethodAmbiguity: Specimen captures and fisher interviews both inform the checklist, without a per-taxon/per-site method crosswalk. Do not turn every table remark into a collection-backed occurrence.
qualityAndRights.timeLimit: All survey evidence is historical (2008-2009); the paper does not establish current presence, abundance, catchability, or condition.
qualityAndRights.rightsCheck: The publicly hosted article PDF, official journal archive entry, and available journal author instructions were reviewed. No article-specific open license or copyright/reuse permission was identified. The source is not cleared for copying its tables, photographs, or row-level compilation into Bangwit.
qualityAndRights.taxonomyLimit: The published names and identifications have not been independently cross-checked in this step; the paper's identification procedure is not itself a current taxonomic authority.

disposition.use: Historical source lead for the Benguet/CAR freshwater inventory; retain only a citation and scope/quality notes pending rights and specimen crosswalk clarification.
disposition.nextAction: Prepare an unsent author/BSU inquiry requesting the 11-site-to-12-unit crosswalk, per-taxon collection versus interview provenance, specimen catalogue numbers, and applicable dataset/table reuse terms. Continue separately with sources whose record-level evidence and reuse rights are independently clear.

sources.supports: Full 27-page source article, including its methods, map, tables and annexes.
Official Museum of Brăila publication archive linking the article as Volume 8, entry 204.
Journal author instructions; searches for copyright, license, rights, and permission found no matching text.
